G1300.def:
δια-τελέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Dt 9:7 (הָיָה), Jr 20:7, 18 (כָּלָה), Et 8:13, 2Ma.5:27 * ;]
prop. trans., to accomplish; used with ellipse of obj. as intrans. (Bl., § 81, 1), and joined to participles (in Ac, Lc., to adj.; see Bl., § 73, 4) with adverbial sense (= continuously), to continue: At 27:33.†
(AS)

G1301.def:
δια-τηρέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for שָׁמַר, נָצַר, etc.; before ἀπό (for מִן), as in Sl 12:7 (8) ;]
to keep carefully: Lc 2:51; before ἐκ, At 15:29.†
(AS)

G1303.def:
δια-τίθημι
[in LXX chiefly for כָּרַת, frequently δ. διαθήκην (כָּרַת) ;]
to place separately, arrange, dispose. Mid, only in NT;
__1. (a) in general, to dispose of; with dative of person(s), to assign to one, Lc 22:29;
__(b) to dispose of by a will, make a testament (in cl., δ. διαθήκην also in this sense): Hb 9:16-17 (but cf. R, mg., and see: διαθήκη).
__2. δ. διαθήκην, to make a covenant (Aristoph.): with dative of person(s), Hb 8:10 (LXX); before πρ, with accusative of person(s), At 3:25, Hb 10:16" (LXX) (cf. ἀντι-διατίθημι).†
(AS)

G1304.def:
δια-τρίβω
[in LXX Lv 14:8 (יָשַׁב), Jr 35:7 (גּוּר), Tob.11:8, 12, Jdth.10:2, 2Ma.14:23 * ;]
to rub hard, rub away, consume; δ. χρόνον, ἡμέρας, to spend time: At 14:3, 28 16:12 20:6 25:6, 14. Intransitively with ellipse of object (El., § 81, 1), to spend time, stay: Jo 3:22 11:54, At 15:35, At 12:19.†
(AS)

G1305.def:
δια-τροφή, ῆς, ἡ
(διατρέφω, to support, sustain), [in LXX: 1Ma.6:49 * ;]
food, nourishment: 1Tm 6:8.†
(AS)

G1308.def:
δια-φέρω
[in LXX for שְׁנָא (שְׁנָא (Dn 7:1-28 only); 1Rs 17:39, Et 3:13, al. ;]
__1. trans.,
__(a) to carry through: before διά, Mc 11:16;
__(b) to carry about, spread abroad: pass., At 13:49 27:27.
__2. Intrans.,
__(a) to differ: τὰ διαφέροντα, Rm 2:18, Fp 1:10 (R, mg., but see infr.); impers., διαφέρει, it makes a difference, it matters: Gl 2:6;
__(b) to excel: with genitive Mt 6:26 10:31 12:12, Lc 12:7, 24, 1Co 15:41, Gl 4:1; τὰ διαφέροντα, Rm 2:18, Fp 1:10 (R, txt.; for discussion and reff. see ICC on Ro, Phi, ll. with).†
(AS)

G1309.def:
δια-φεύγω
[in LXX: Js 8:22 (פָּלִיט), Js 10:28 (שָׂרִיד), etc. ;]
to flee through, escape: At 27:42.†
(AS)

G1310.def:
δια-φημίζω
in late writers only, to spread abroad: τ. λόγον (= דָּבָר, the matter), Mc 1:45, Mt 28:15; with accusative of person(s), to spread abroad one's fame: Mt 9:31.†
(AS)

G1311.def:
δια-φθείρω
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁחַת hi. ;]
__1. to destroy utterly: Lc 12:33, Ap 11:18; pass., to be destroyed, disabled: Ap 8:9, 2Co 4:16.
__2. In moral sense, to corrupt, deprave: τ. γῆν, Ap 11:18; pass., διεφθαρμένοι τ. νοῦν, 1Tm 6:5.†
(AS)

G1312.def:
δια-φθορὰ, -ᾶς, ἡ
(διαφθείρω), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁחַת, and cogn. forms ;]
__1. destruction.
__2. corruption (physical or moral): of the grave, At 2:27 (LXX), At 2:31 13:34-37.†
(AS)

G1313.def:
διά-φορος, -ον
(διαφέρω), [in LXX for שְׁנָא (Dn 7:7, 19); also as in Polyb., iv, 188, al., Τὸ δ., τὰ δ., money: Sir.27:1 42:5, 2Ma.3:6 ;]
__1. different: Rm 12:6, Hb 9:10.
__2. excellent: compar., -ώτερος, Hb 1:4 8:6.†
(AS)

G1314.def:
δια-φυλάσσω
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁמַר (as Sl 91:11) ;]
to guard carefully (M, Pr., 116), defend: with accusative, Lc 4:10 (LXX).†
(AS)

G1315.def:
δια-χειρίζω
(χείρ),
to have in hand, conduct, manage. Mid.
__(a) = act.;
__(b) in late writers (Polyb., FlJ, al.), to lay hands on, kill: with accusative, At 5:30 26:21.†
(AS)

G1316.def:
δια-χωρίζω
[in LXX: Gn 1:4 ff (בָּדַל hi.), Gn 13:9 ff. (פָּרַד ni.), etc. ;]
to separate entirely. Mid., to separate oneself, depart: before ἀπό Lc 9:33.†
(AS)

G1318.def:
διδακτός, -ή, -όν
(διδάσκω), [in LXX: Is 54:13 (לִמּוּד), 1Ma.4:7 * ;]
__1. that can be taught.
__2. taught; with genitive, of source of teaching (in cl., poët. only);
__(a) of persons: δ. θεοῦ, Jo 6:45 (LXX);
__(b) of things, λόγοις δ. πνεύματος, 1Co 2:13.†
(AS)

G1319.def:
διδασκαλία, -ας, ἡ
(διδάσκω), [in LXX: Pv 2:17 (אַלּוּף), Is 29:13 (לָמַד), Sir.24:33 39:8 * ;]
teaching, instruction, in both active and objective senses, most frequently the latter: Rm 12:7 15:4, Ef 4:14, 1Tm 4:6, 13, 16 5:17 6:1, 3, 2Tm 3:10 3:16, Tt 2:7, 10; ὑγιαινοῦσα δ., 1Tm 1:10, 2Tm 4:3, Tt 1:9 2:1; pl., δ. τ. ἀνθρώπων, Cl 2:22; δ. δαιμονίων, 1Tm 4:1, δ. διδάσκειν, Mt 15:9, Mc 7:7" (LXX) (Cremer, 182).†
SYN.: διδαχή (AS)

G1320.def:
διδάσκαλος, -ου, ὁ
(διδάσκω), [in LXX: Et 6:1, 2Ma.1:10 * ;]
given as rendering of Heb. רַבִּי ,רַבּוֺן (NT, Ῥαββεί, Ῥαββουνεί which see);
a teacher: Jo 1:39 20:16; of Jewish teachers, Lc 2:46, Jo 3:10, cf. Rm 2:20-21; of John Baptist, Lc 3:12; of Jesus, Jo 3:2, 10 8:4 11:28 13:13-14, and often in Syn., most frequently in voc., as title of address, as Mt 8:19, Mc 4:38; of Jesus by himself, Mt 23:8; of an apostle, 1Tm 2:7, 2Tm 1:11; of Christians, 1Co 12:28-29, Ef 4:11, At 13:1, Tg 3:1; of false teachers, 2Tm 4:3 (Cremer, 181; DB, i, 609, iii, 294, iv, 691)
SYN.: παιδευτής, q.v (AS)

G1321.def:
διδάσκω
[in LXX chiefly for למד pl., also for ידע hi., ירה hi., etc. ;]
to teach (i.e. instruct) a person, teach a thing;
__1. trans.: with accusative of person(s), Mt 5:2, Mc 1:22, al.; before ὅτι, Mc 8:31; περί, 1Jo 2:27; with inf., Lc 11:1; with accusative of thing(s), Mc 6:30 12:14; with cogn. accusative, Mt 15:9 (LXX); with dupl. accusative, Mc 4:2, Jo 14:26; pass., Gl 1:12, 2Ts 2:15; with dative of person(s) (like Heb., cf. Jó 21:23, but prob. a vernac. usage, see Swete, in l.), Ap 2:14.
__2. Absol., to teach, give instruction: Mt 4:23, Mc 1:21, and often in Gosp., Rm 12:7, 1Co 4:17, 1Tm 2:12, al.
SYN.: παιδεύω (cf. Westc., Heb., 402; Cremer, 180). (AS)

G1322.def:
διδαχή, -ῆς, ἡ
(διδάσκω), [in LXX: Sl 60:1-12 title. (לָמַד pi.); Sm.: Dt 33:8 * ;]
__1. objectively, teaching, doctrine, that which is taught: Mc 1:27, Jo 7:16, At 17:19, Rm 6:7 16:17, 2Jn.10, Ap 2:24; with genitive poss., Mt 7:28 16:12 22:33, Mc 1:22 11:18, Lc 4:32, Jo 18:19, At 5:28, Ap 2:14-15; ἡ δ., of Christ, Jo 7:17, At 13:12, 2Jn.9; of. τὴν δ., Tt 1:9; with genitive obj., βαπτισμῶν δ., Hb 6:2; pl., Hb 13:9.
__2. Actively, teaching: At 2:42, 2Tm 4:2; ἐν τ. δ., in the course of his teaching: Mc 4:2 12:38; λαλεῖν ἐν δ., 1Co 14:6; ἔχειν δ., 1Co 14:26 (DCG, i, 485; Cremer, 181).†
SYN.: διδασκαλία (AS)

G1323.def:
δίδραχμος, -ον
(δίς, δραχμή),
worth two drachmae; τὸ δ. (sc. νόμισμα, coin),
[in LXX chiefly for שֶׁקֶל (Gn 23:15, a1.), also for כֶּסֶף: Gn 20:16, Dt 22:29 ;]
a double drachma, nearly equal to the Jewish half-shekel, the amount of the Temple tax: Mt 17:24 (DB, iii, 428).†
(AS)

G1324.def:
Δίδυμος, -ου, ὁ
(prop. name from δίδυμος, -η, -ον, double, sc. παῖς, twin)
Didymus, surname of the apostle Thomas: Jo 11:16 20:24 21:2.†
(AS)

G1325.def:
δίδωμι,
[in LXX chiefly for נָתַן (53 words in all) ;]
to give—in various senses, accusative to context—bestow, grant, supply, deliver, commit, yield: absol., At 20:35; with accusative of thing(s) and dative of person(s), Mt 4:9 5:31, Jo 1:12, al. mult.; with dative of person(s), before ἐκ, Mt 25:8; id. with genitive part.. Ap 2:17; with accusative of person(s), Jo 3:16, Ap 20:13, al.; δεξιάς, Gl 2:9; φίλημα, Lc 7:45; γνῶσιν, Lc 1:77; κρίσιν, Jo 5:22; of seed yielding fruit, Mc 4:7, 8; ἐργασίαν (Deiss., LAE, 117f.), Lc 12:58; with inf. fin., Mt 27:34, Mc 5:43, Lc 8:55, Jo 6:52, al.; with dative of person(s) and inf., Lc 1:74, al.; with accusative and inf., At 2:27, Ap 3:9; with dupl. accusative, Mt 20:28, Mc 10:45, Ef 1:22 4:11, 2Ts 3:9, 1Tm 2:6, al.; ἑαυτὸν δ. εἰς (Polyb., al.), At 19:31; with dative of person(s), before κατά (MM, Exp., xi), Ap 2:28 (LXX); δ. ἵνα, Ap 3:9; δέδωκα ἐνώπιόν σου θύραν ἀνεῳγμένην, Ap 3:8.
SYN.: δωρέομαι. (AS)

G1326.def:
δι-εγείρω
[in LXX: Jdth.1:4, Et 1:1, 2Ma.7:21 2Mac 15:10, 3Ma.5:15 * ;]
to arouse completely, arouse as from rest or sleep: Lc 8:24; pass., Mc 4:39, Lc 8:24; of the sea, Jo 6:18. Metaphorical, of the mind: ἐν ὑπομνήσει, 2Pe 1:13 3:1.†
(AS)

G1327.def:
δι-έ-οδος, -ου, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for תּוֹצָאָה, as Nm 34:4ff, and frequently in Jos;]
in π. of the conclusion of a trial (MM, Exp., xi); a way out through, an outlet; pl., δ. τῶν ὁδῶν, RV, the partings of the highways: Mt 22:9.†
(AS)

G1329.def:
δι-ερμηνεύω
[in LXX: 2Ma.1:36 * ;]
intensive of ἐρμηνεύω, to interpret;
__(a) to explain, expound: with accusative, Lc 24:27; absol., 1Co 12:30 14:5 14:13 14:27;
__(b) to translate: At 9:36.†
(AS)

G1330.def:
δι-έρχομαι
[in LXX for אֵבֶר, הָלַךְ, בּוֹא, etc. ;]
__1. to go through, pass through;
__(a) of things: Mt 19:24, Mc 10:25, Lc 2:35, al.;
__(b) of persons: Lc 19:4; with accusative loc., Lc 19:1, Hb 4:14, At 12:10; before διά, with genitive loc., Mt 12:43, 1Co 10:1; before εἰς, Mc 4:35; ἕως, Lc 2:15.
__2. to go about: Lc 9:6, At 20:25; of a report, to spread, go abroad (Thuc.), Lc 5:15
(AS)

G1331.def:
δι-ερωτάω, -ῶ
to find by inquiry: with accusative, At 10:17.†
(AS)

G1332.def:
διετής, -ές
(δίς, ἔτος), [in LXX: 2Ma.10:3 * ;]
__1. lasting two years.
__2. two years old: ἀπὸ δ. (sc. παιδός, or neuter; cf. 1Cr 27:23, ἀπὸ εἰκοσαετοῦς), Mt 2:16.†
(AS)

G1333.def:
διετία, -ας, ἡ
(διετής), [in LXX (Græc. Ven.): Gn 41:1 45:5 * ;]
the space of two years: At 24:27 28:30.†
(AS)

G1334.def:
δι-ηγέομαι, -οῦμαι
[in LXX chiefly for סָפַר pi. ;]
to set out in detail, recount, describe: absol., Hb 11:32; with accusative of thing(s), At 8:33; with dative of person(s), before πῶς, Mc 5:16, At 9:27 12:17; ἅ εἶδον, Mc 9:9; ὅσα ἐποίησε, -αν, Lc 8:39 9:10.†
(AS)

G1335.def:
δι-ήγησις, -εως, ἡ
(διηγέομαι), [in LXX: Jz 7:15 מִסְפָּר Hc 2:6 חִידָה), frequently in (Sir.6:35, al.), 2Ma.2:32 2Mac 6:17 ;]
a narrative: Lc 1:1 (cf. Milligan, NTD, 130).†
(AS)

G1336.def:
δι-ηνεκής, -ές
(διήνεγκα, aorist of διαφέρω) [in Sm.: Sl 48:15, 89:30 ;]
unbroken, continuous: adverbially, εἰς τὸ δ., continually (for exx., see Deiss., BS, 251), Hb 7:3 10:1, 12 10:14†
(AS)

G1337.def:
διθάλασσος, -ον
(δις, θύλασσα);
__1. divided into two seas (as the Euxine, Strab., ii, 522).
__2. dividing the sea: τόπον δ., a tongue of land, or reef, running out into the sea: At 27:41.†
(AS)

G1338.def:
δι-ικνέομαι (Rec. διϊκ-), -οῦμαι,
[in LXX for בָּרַח hi., Êx 26:28 * ;]
to go through, penetrate: Hb 4:12.†
(AS)

G1339.def:
δι-ίσπημι
(Rec. διΐσ), [in LXX: Eze.5:1 (חָלַק pi.), Pv 17:9 (פָּרַד hi.), etc. ;]
to set apart, separate; of time (or space), to make an interval, intervene: διαστάσης ὥρας μιᾶς, Lc 22:59; βραχὺ διαστήσαντες, At 27:28. In pass., mid. and 2 aor., pf. and plpf. act., to part, withdraw: Lc 24:51.†
(AS)

G1340.def:
δι-ισχυρίζομαι (T, Rec. διϊσ-), depon.;
__1. to lean upon.
__2. to affirm confidently: with ptcp., Lc 22:59; with accusative and inf. (Bl., § 70, 3), At 12:15.†
(AS)

G1341.def:
δικαιοκρισία, -ας, ἡ
righteous judgment: Rm 2:5 (cf. τ. δικαίας κρίσεως, 2Ts 1:5; τὴν δ. κ., Jo 7:24. For use in π., see Deiss., LAE, 89 f.).†
(AS)

G1342.def:
δίκαιος, -α, -ον
(δίκη), [in LXX chiefly for צַדִּיק (for rendering of צַדִּיק in sense of correct, see Deiss., BS, 115 f.); sometimes for נָקִי as Pv 1:11, al. ;]
in early Gk. writers
__(a) of persons, observant of δίκη, custom, rule, right, righteous in performing duties to gods and men ;
__(b) of things, righteous, in accordance with right.
In NT
__1. righteous, chiefly in the broad sense, as above, of the person or thing corresponding to the Divine standard of right
__(a) of persons: of God, Rm 3:26, 1Jo 2:29 Jn 3:7; of Christ, At 3:14 7:52 22:14, 1Pe 3:18, 1Jo 2:1; of men, Mt 1:19 (Abbott, Essays, 75 f.) Mt 10:41 13:17, 43 13:49, Lc 1:6, 17, Rm 5:7, 1Tm 1:9, Tg 5:6, 1Pe 3:12, 1Jo 3:7, Ap 22:11, al.; δ. καὶ εὐλαβής, Lc 2:25; ἅγιος, Mc 6:20; ἀγαθός, Lc 23:50; φοβούμενος τ. θεόν, At 10:22; opposite to ἀμαρτωλοὶ καὶ ἀσεβεῖς, 1Pe 4:18; ἄδικοι, Mt 5:45, At 24:15; δ. ἐκ πίστεως, Rm 1:17, Gl 3:11, Hb 10:38" (LXX) ; δ. παρὰ τ. θεῷ, Rm 2:13
__(b) of things: ἔργα δ., opposite to πονηρὰ, 1Jo 3:12; ἐντολή, Rm 7:12; metaphorically, αἷμα, Mt 23:35; τὸ δ., Lc 12:57; δ. ἐστιν, At 4:19, Ef 6:1, Fp 1:7; ὅ, Mt 20:4; ὅσα, Fp 4:8
__2. In narrower sense
__(a) of persons, as in later cl. writers, just, rendering to each his due: Tt 1:8, 1Jo 1:9; δ. κριτής, 2Tm 4:8
__(b) of things: τὸ δ., Cl 4:1; δ., sc. ἐστιν, 2Ts 1:6; κρίσις δ., Jo 5:30; ὁδοί, Ap 15:3
SYN.: ἀγαθός (which see), καλός, χρηστός (Cremer, 183, 690). (AS)

G1343.def:
δικαιοσύνη, -ης, ἡ
(δίκαιος), [in LXX chiefly for צֶדֶק, and cognates, Gn 15:6, al., rarely for חֶסֶד, Gn 19:19 ;]
the character of ὁ δίκαιος (which see)
__1. in broad sense, righteousness, conformity to the Divine will in purpose, thought and action: Mt 5:6, Jo 16:8, At 13:10, Rm 4:3; λόγος δικαιοσύνης, teaching of r., Hb 5:13; βασιλεὺς δ. (cf. FlJ, BJ, vi, 10, β. δίκαιος), Hb 7:2; ὅπλα δ., Rm 6:13; ὁδὸς δ., Mt 21:32; θώραξ τῆς δ., Ef 6:14; διὰκονοι δ., 2Co 11:15; ὁσιότης καὶ δ., Lc 1:75, cf. Ef 4:24; ἀγαθωσύνῃ καὶ δ., Ef 5:9; δ. κ. εἰρήνη κ. χαρά, Rm 14:17; δ. κ. ἁγιασμός, 1Co 1:30; opposite to ἁμαρτία, Rm 8:10; ἀνομία, 2Co 6:14; άδικία, Rm 3:5; ποιεῖν τὴν δ., 1Jo 2:29 Jn 3:7; id. as an inclusive term for the active duties of the religious life (ICC, in l; Abbott, Essays, 73 ff), Mt 6:1; ἐργάζεσθαι δ., At 10:35; διώκειν δ., 1Tm 6:11; πληροῦν πᾶσαν δ., Mt 3:15; ζῆν τῇ δ., 1Pe 2:24; δ. θεοῦ, a righteousness divine in its character and origin, Mt 6:33, Tg 1:20, (where it also includes the idea of God's personal r.; see ICC, on Rm 1:17) Rm 1:17 3:5, 21-26 10:3, 2Co 5:21, Fp 3:9; ἡ δ. τ. πίσιεως, Rm 4:11; ἡ ἐκ π. δ., Rm 9:30; ἡ κατὰ π. δ., Hb 11:7; opposite to this is ἡ ἐκ νόμου δ., Rm 10:5; ἡ δ. ἐν ν., Fp 3:6; ἡ ἰδία δ., Rm 10:3, cf. Fp 3:9
__2. In narrower sense (cf. δίκαιος), justice: At 17:31, 2Pe 1:1, Ap 19:11 (DCG, ii, 529 ff.; Cremer, 190, 690).
(AS)

G1344.def:
δικαιόω, -ῶ
(δίκαιος), [in LXX chiefly for צָדַק pi., hi., (1) as Eze.16:51, Jr 3:11 (cf. NT usage); (2) as Dt 25:1; Êx 23:7, Is 50:8 ;]
__1. in cl.,
__(a) with accusative of thing(s), to deem right;
__(b) with accusative of person(s), to do one justice; pass., δικαιοῦσθαι, to be treated rightly, opposite to ἀδικεῖσθαι.
__2. In NT, as in LXX, and as usual with verbs in -όω from adjectives of moral meaning;
__(1) to show to be righteous: Mt 11:19, Lc 7:35, Rm 3:4" (LXX), 1Tm 3:16;
__(2) to declare, pronounce righteous: Lc 7:29 10:29 16:15 18:14, Rm 2:13 3:24, 26 3:28 4:5 8:30, 33, Tt 3:7; before ἀπό, Mt 11:19, Lc 7:35, At 13:39, Rm 6:7; ἐκ πίστεως, Rm 3:30 5:1, Gl 2:16 3:8, 24; ἐξ ἔργων, Rm 3:20 (LXX) Rm 4:2, Gl 2:16, Tg 2:21, 24-25; ἐκ τ. λόγων, Mt 12:37; διὰ τ. πίστεως, Rm 3:30; with dative, Rm 3:24, 28, Tt 3:7; before ἐν, At 13:39, Rm 3:4 5:9, 1Co 4:4 6:11, Gl 2:17 3:11 5:4, 1Tm 3:16 (see Cremer, 193, 693; DB, ii, 826 ff.).†
(AS)

G1345.def:
δικαίωμα, -τος, τ
(δικαιόω), [in LXX most frequently for חֹק, in Ez, chiefly for מִשְׁפָּט, in Pss, τὰ δ., frequently for פִּקּוּד ;]
a concrete expression of righteousness, the expression and result of the act of δικαίωσις, "a declaration that a thing is δίκαιον, or that a person is δίκαιος," hence,
__(a) an ordinance: δ. τ. θεοῦ, Rm 1:32; τ. κυρίου, Lc 1:6; τ. νόμου, Rm 2:26 8:4; λατρείας, Hb 9:1; σαρκός, Hb 9:10;
__(b) a sentence: of acquittal, Rm 5:16 (also Rm 5:18; ICC, in l), or of condemnation;
__(with) a righteous act: Rm 5:18 (RV), Ap 15:4 19:8 (on the usage of π., see MM, Exp., iii, xi).
† (AS)

G1346.def:
δικαίως
adv. (δίκαιος, which see), [in LXX for צֶדֶק, etc. ;]
__1. righteously: 1Co 15:34, 1Ts 2:10, Tt 2:12.
__2. justly: Lc 23:41, 1Pe 2:23.†
(AS)

G1347.def:
δικαίωσις, -εως, ἡ
(δικαιόω), [in LXX for מִשְׁפָּט, Lv 24:22 * ;]
the act of pronouncing righteous, justification, acquittal: Rm 4:25 5:18 (Cremer, 199).†
(AS)

G1348.def:
δικαστής, -οῦ, ὁ
(δικάζω), [in LXX for שָׁפַט ;]
a judge: At 7:27, 35" (LXX) .†
SYN.: κριτής, WH. "gives prominence to the mental process" (Thayer). δ. is the forensic term. In Attic law, the δικασταί were jurors, with a κριτής as presiding officer (LS, see word; Enc. Brit. 11, xii, 504 f.) (AS)

G1349.def:
δίκη, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX for נָקָם, רִיב, etc. ;]
__1. custom.
__2. right.
__3. a judicial hearing; hence its result, the execution of a sentence, punishment: δ. τίνειν, 2Ts 1:9; δ. υπεχειν, Ju 7.
__4. Personified (cf. Lat. Justitia), justice, vengeance: At 28:4.†
(AS)

G1350.def:
δίκτυον, -ον, τό
[in LXX chiefly for רֶשֶׁת, שְׂבָכָה ;]
general term for a net: Mt 4:20-21, Mc 1:18-19, Lc 5:2, 4-6, Jo 21:6, 8 21:11 †
SYN.: ἀμφίβληστρον (which see), σαγήνη. (AS)

G1351.def:
διλογος, -ον
(δίς, λέγω),
__1. in sense of διλογεῖν, -ία (Xen.), given to repetition.
__2. In NT, prob. (cf. δίγλωσσος, Pv 11:13, Sir.5:9) double-tongued: 1Tm 3:8.†
(AS)

G1352.def:
διό
conjunct. for δι᾽ ὅ,
wherefore, on which account: Mt 27:8, Lc 7:7, At 15:19, Rm 1:24, al.; δ. καί, Lc 1:35, At 10:29 24:26, Rm 4:22 15:22, 2Co 1:20 4:13 5:9, Fp 2:9, Hb 11:12 13:12 (see Ellic. on Gl 4:31).
(AS)

G1353.def:
δι-οδεύω,
[in LXX chiefly for עבר ;]
__1. to travel through: with accusative, At 17:1
__2. to travel along (Bar.4:2, 1Ma.12:32-33): Lc 8:1.†
(AS)

G1355.def:
διό-περ conjunct. (διό, which see, strengthened by πέρ),
[in LXX: Jdth.8:17; Jdt.8.1-36; 2Ma.5:1-27 * ;]
for which very reason: 1Co 8:13 10:14.†
(AS)

G1356.def:
διοπετής (written also διϊπ-), -ές
(δῖος, πίπτω, see Page on Ac, l.with; DB, i, 605, n., ext., 112a; Field, Notes, 130 f.),
fallen from heaven (R, mg.): τὸ δ. (sc. ἄγαλμα, statue, image), At 19:35.†
(AS)

G1357.def:
διόρθωσις, -εως, ἡ (see supr.),
__1. a making straight.
__2. a reforming, reformation (used in late writers of laws, etc.): Hb 9:10 (Cremer, 807).†
διόρθωμα, -τος, τό
(διορθόω, to make straight, set right),
a correction, reform: At 24:3.†
διόρθωσις, -εως, ἡ (see supr.),
__1. a making straight.
__2. a reforming, reformation (used in late writers of laws, etc.): Hb 9:10 (Cremer, 807).†
(AS)

G1358.def:
δι-ορύσσω
[in LXX: Jó 24:16, Êx 12:5, 7 12:12, (חָתַר) * ;]
to dig through: with accusative, of house-breaking (as in π.; MM, Exp., xi), Mt 24:43, Lc 12:39; absol., Mt 6:19-20.†
(AS)

G1359.def:
Διόσ-κουροι, -ων, οἱ
(Ion. and κοινή form of Att..., Διόσκοροι; Διός, genitive of Ζεύς + κόρος, a son),
the Dioscuri (Castor and Pollux), twin sons of Zeus and Leda (RV, The Twin Brothers): At 28:11.†
(AS)

G1360.def:
δι-ότι , conjunct., for διὰ τοῦτο, ὅτι (Lat. propterea quod),
because: Lc 1:13 2:7 21:28, At 13:35 18:10 20:26 22:18, Rm 1:19, 21 3:20 8:7, 21, 1Co 15:9, Fp 2:26, 1Ts 2:8, 18 (Lft., Notes, 37) 1Ts 4:6, Hb 11:5, 23, Tg 4:3, 1Pe 1:16 1:24 2:6. It is usually stronger than ὅτι, but sometimes, as in Lc 1:13, Rm 1:19, 1Ts 2:18, approximates to MGr. sense, for; cf. Milligan, Th., l.with†
(AS)

G1361.def:
Διοτρέφης (Rec. -τρεψής), -ες
(Διός, genitive of Ζεύς + τρέφω: cherished by Zeus),
as proper name, Diotrephes: III Jn 9.†
(AS)

G1362.def:
διπλόος
(poët., διπλός, whence corp. -ότερον), -όη, -όον (-οῦ, -ῆ, -οῦν) [in LXX for כָּפַל, מִשְׁנֶה, and cognates ;]
twofold, double: 1Tm 5:17, Ap 18:6; διπλότιρον, in twofold measure: Mt 23:15.†
(AS)

G1364.def:
δίς
adv.,
twice: Mc 14:30, 72; δ. τ. σαββάτου, Lc 18:12; καὶ ἅπαξ κ. δ., Fp 4:16, 1Ts 2:18; δ. ἀποθανόντα, Ju 12 (see Mayor, ICC, in l); δ. μυριάδες, Ap 9:16.†
(AS)

G1365.def:
διστάζω
(δίς),
to doubt, hesitate: Mt 14:31 28:17.†
SYN.: ἀπορέω, διαπορέω, διακρίνομαι, μετεωρίζομαι (see DCG, i, 491) (AS)

G1366.def:
δίστομος, -ον
(δίς, στόμα), [in LXX: Jz 3:16, Sl 149:6, Pv 5:4 (פֶּה), Sir.21:3 * ;]
__1. of rivers and roads, double-mouthed, double branching.
__2. Of swords (Eur.; LXX, ll with), two-edged: Hb 4:12, Ap 1:16 2:12.†
(AS)

G1367.def: two thousand , (Herdotus Historicus):—;singular with collective nouns, δισχιλίη ἵππος 2000 horse, (Herdotus Historicus) (ML)

G1368.def:
δι-υλίζω
(δια, ὑλίζω, to strain) [in LXX: Am 6:6 * ;]
__1. to strain thoroughly (Archytas; Am., l.with).
__2. Later, to strain out: figuratively, Mt 23:24.†
(AS)

G1369.def:
διχάζω
(δίχα, apart), [in Aq.: Lv 1:17, Dt 14:6 * ;]
to cut apart, divide in two; metaphorically, to set at variance: Mt 10:35.†
(AS)

G1370.def:
διχοστασία, -ας, ἡ
(διχοστατέω, to stand apart), [in LXX: 1Ma.3:29 * ;]
standing apart, dissension: Rm 16:17, Gl 5:20.†
(AS)

G1371.def:
διχοτομέω, -ῶ
(διχοτόμος, δίχα, τέμνω), [in LXX: Êx 29:17 (נָתַח pi.) ;]
to cut in two, cut asunder: perh. metaphorically of severe scourging (but see Meyer on Mt, l.with, and cf. 1Rs 15:33, 2Rs 12:31, Hb 11:37), Mt 24:51, Lc 12:46.†
(AS)

G1372.def:
διψάω,-ῶ
(δίψα, thirst), [in LXX chiefly for צָמֵא ;]
to thirst: absol., Mt 25:35, 37 25:42, 44, Jo 4:13, 15 19:28, Rm 12:20" (LXX), 1Co 4:11; figuratively, Jo 4:14 6:35 7:37, Ap 7:16 21:6 22:17; with accusative (= cl. with genitive), τ. δικαιοσύνην, Mt 5:6.†
(AS)

G1373.def:
δίψος, -εος (-ους), τό
(late form of δίψα), [in LXX chiefly for and cognates ;]
thirst: 2Co 11:27.†
(AS)

G1374.def:
δίψυχος, -ον
(δίς, ψυχή),
of two minds, wavering: Tg 1:8 4:8 (Cremer, 588; DB, iv, 528).†
(AS)

G1375.def:
διωγμός, -oῦ, ὁ
(διώκω), [in LXX: Pv 11:19 (רָדַף pi.), La 3:19 (מָרוּד), 2Ma.12:23 * ;]
persecution: Mt 13:21, Mc 4:17 10:30 At 8:1 13:50, Rm 8:35, 2Co 12:10, 2Ts 1:4, 2Tm 3:11.†
(AS)

G1377.def:
διώκω
[in LXX chiefly for רָדַף ;]
__1. to put to flight, drive away: Mt 23:34.
__2. to pursue;
__(a) of persons; with accusative, without hostility, to follow after: Lc 17:23; with hostile purpose: At 26:11, Ap 12:13. Hence, to persecute: Mt 5:10-12, 44 10:23, Lc 11:49 21:12, Jo 5:16 15:20, At 7:52 9:4-5 22:4, 7-8 26:14-15 Rm 12:14, 1Co 4:12 15:9, 2Co 4:9, Gl 1:13, 23 4:29 5:11 6:12, Fp 3:6, 2Tm 3:12;
__(b) metaphorically, with accusative of thing(s), of seeking eagerly after: Rm 9:30, 1Tm 6:11, 2Tm 2:22; νόμον δικαιοσύνης, Rm 9:31; τ. φιλοξενίαν, Rm 12:13; εἰρήνην, Hb 12:14, 1Pe 3:11; τὰ τῆς εἰ., Rm 14:19; τ. ἀγάπην, 1Co 14:1; τὸ ἀγαθόν, 1Ts 5:15; absol., to follow on, drive, or speed on (Æsch.), Fp 3:12, 14.†
(AS)

G1378.def:
δόγμα, -τος, τό
(δοκέω), [in LXX chiefly for דָּת, טְעֵם ;]
__1. an opinion.
__2. A public decree, ordinance: of Roman rulers, Lc 2:1, At 17:7; of the Jewish law, Ef 2:15, Cl 2:14; of the Apostles, At 16:4 (Cremer, 205).†
(AS)

G1379.def:
δογματίζω
[in LXX: Et 3:9 (כָּתַב ni.), Dan LXX 2:13, 15 (דָּת), I Et 6:34, 2Ma.10:3 2Mac 15:36, 3Ma.4:11 * ;]
to decree. Mid., to subject oneself to an ordinance: Cl 2:20.†
(AS)

G1380.def:
δοκέω, -ῶ
(δόκος, opinion, δέκομαι, Ion, form of δέχ-), [in LXX for טוֹב, נָדַב, etc. ;]
__1. to be of opinion, suppose: Mt 24:44, Lc 12:40, Hb 10:29; with inf., Mt 3:9, Lc 8:18 24:37, Jo 5:39 16:2, At 12:9 27:13, 1Co 3:18 7:40 8:2 10:12 14:37, Gl 6:3, Fp 3:4, Tg 1:26; with accusative and inf., 1Co 12:23, 2Co 11:16; before ὅτι, Mt 6:7 26:53, Mc 6:49, Lc 12:51 13:2, 4 19:11, Jo 5:45 11:13, 31 13:29 20:15, 1Co 4:9, 2Co 12:19, Tg 4:5.
__2. to seem, be reputed: At 25:27; with inf., Mc 10:42, Lc 10:36 22:24, At 17:13 26:9, 1Co 11:16 12:22, 2Co 10:9, Gl 2:6, 9, Hb 4:1 12:11; οἱ δοκοῦντες, those of repute, Gl 2:2. Impers., it seems, with dative of person(s);
__(a) to think: Mt 17:25 18:12 21:28 22:17, 42 26:66, Jo 11:56, Hb 12:10;
__(b) to please, seem good to: with inf., Lc 1:3, At 15:22, 25 15:23, 34.†
SYN. (δοκέω 1): ἡγέομαι 2, νομίζω2, οἴομαι; ἡ. and ν. properly express belief resting on external proof, ἡ. denoting the more careful judgment; δ. and οἴ. imply a subjective judgment which in the case of οἴ. is based on feeling, in δ. on thought (see Schmidt, with 17) (δοκέω2): φαίνομαι; φ., from the standpoint of the object, "expresses how a matter phenomenally shows and presents itself"; δ., from the standpoint of the observer, expresses one's subjective judgment about a matter (see Tr., Syn., LXXx; Cremer, 204). (AS)

G1381.def:
δοκιμάζω
(δόκιμος), [in LXX chiefly for בָּחַן ;]
__1. primarily of metals (Pv 8:10 17:3, Sir.2:5, Wis.3:6), to test, try, prove (in the hope and expectation that the test will prove successful, see reff. s. Syn.): χρυσίον, 1Pe 1:7; other things, Lc 12:56 14:19, 2Co 8:8, Gl 6:4, 1Ts 2:4 5:21; τὰ διαφέροντα, Rm 2:18, Fp 1:10 (R, mg., but see infr.); πνεύματα, 1Jo 4:1; of men, 1Tm 3:10 (pass.); ἑαυτόν, 1Co 11:28, 2Co 13:5; before subst. clause, Rm 12:2, 1Co 3:13, Ef 5:10
__2. As the result of trial, to approve, think fit: Rm 1:28 14:22, 1Co 16:3, 2Co 8:22, 1Ts 2:4 (δεδοκιμάσμεθα); τὰ διαφέροντα, Rm 2:18, Fp 1:10, R, txt. (but see supr.; cf. διαφέρω).†
(AS)

G1382.def:
δοκιμή, -ῆς, ἡ
(δόκιμος), [in Sm.: Sl 68:31 * ;]
__1. the process of trial, proving, test: 2Co 8:2 9:13
__2. The result of trial, approval, approvedness, proof: Rm 5:4, 2Co 2:9 13:3, Fp 2:22 (Cremer, 212, 701).†
(AS)

G1383.def:
δοκίμιον, -ου, τό
[in LXX: Pv 17:3 27:21 (מִצְרֵף) * ;]
usually regarded as a variant form of δοκιμεῖον, a test, and so perh. Tg 1:3 (see Mayor, in l), but see next word (cf. Cremer, 212, 702).†
(AS)

G1384.def:
δοκίμιος, -α, -ον
(δοκιμή), [in LXX: ἀργύριον δ. (עֲלִיל), Sl 12:6; and as seel. for δόκιμος (B), ἀργυρίου δ. (זָקַק pual.), 1Cr 29:4 (Bab); εἰ δ .ίστιν (יְקָר), Zc 11:13 א with a vid, Q *)* ;]
= δόκιμος,
tested, approved: τὸ δ. ὑμῶν τ. πίστεως, that which is approved in your faith, 1Pe 1:7 (where Hort suggests the seel. δόκιμος, found in some cursives), Tg 1:3 (but see Mayor, in l For full discussion of this word, not hitherto found in a Gk. Lexicon, and for exx. of its use in π., see Deiss. (to whom is due the credit of its discovery), BS, 259 ff.; MM, Exp., xi; cf. also Milligan, NTD, 76).†
δόκιμος, -ον
(δέκομαι = δέχομαι) [in LXX for זָקַק pual., etc. ;]
primarily of metals, tested, accepted, approved: of persons, Rm 14:18 16:10, 1Co 11:19, 2Co 10:18 13:7, 2Tm 2:15, Tg 1:12 (Cremer, 212, 697).†
(AS)

G1385.def:
δοκός, -οῦ, ἡ
(δέχομαι) [in LXX for קוֹרָה, etc. ;]
a beam of timber: Mt 7:3-5, Lc 6:41-42 (DCG, i, 176).†
(AS)

G1386.def:
δόλιος, -α, -ον
(δόλος), [in LXX—chiefly in Pss, Pr, Sir—for etc. ;]
deceitful: 2Co 11:13.†
(AS)

G1387.def:
δολιόω
(δόλιος), [in LXX: Nm 25:18, Sl 105:25 (נָכַל), Sl 5:6 (חָלַק hi.) * ;]
to deceive: ἐδολιοῦσαν (-σαν, frequently in κοινή Gk. for imperfect 3rd of person(s) pl.), Rm 3:13 (LXX).†
(AS)

G1388.def:
δόλος, -ου, ὁ,
[in LXX chiefly for מִרְמָה;]
__1. in Hom., a bait.
__2. a snare.
__3. In the abstract, craft, deceit: Mt 26:4, Mc 7:22 14:1, Jo 1:47, At 13:10, Rm 1:29, 2Co 12:16, 1Ts 2:3, 1Pe 2:1 2:22 3:10" (LXX) (λαλῆσαι δ.).†
(AS)

G1389.def:
δολόω, -ῶ
(δόλος) [in LXX: Sl 15:3 (רָגַל), Sl 36:2 (חָלַק hi.) * ;]
__1. to ensnare.
__2. As of wine, to adulterate, corrupt: τ. λόγον τ. θεοῦ, 2Co 4:2.†
SYN.: καπηλεύω which see (AS)

G1390.def:
δόμα, -τος, τό
(δίδωμι), [in LXX for מַתָּנָה, etc. ;]
a gift: Mt 7:11, Lc 11:13, Ef 4:8" (LXX), Fp 4:17.†
SYN.: δόσις, δῶρον, δωρεά, δώρημα (AS)

G1391.def:
δόξα, -ης, ἡ
(δοκέω), [in LXX very frequently for כָּבוֹד, also for הוֹד ,פִּפְאֶרֶת, etc., 25 words in all ;]
in cl.,
__1. expectation, judgment, opinion (4Ma.5:18).
__2. opinion, estimation in which one is held, repute; in NT, always good opinion, hence reputation, praise, honour, glory: Lc 14:10, Jo 12:43, Hb 3:3; opposite to αἰσχύνη, Fp 3:19; to ἀτιμία, 2Co 6:8; δ. κ. τιμή, Rm 2:7, 10 1Pe 1:7, 2Pe 1:17; ζητεῖν, Jo 5:44 7:18 8:50, 1Ts 2:6; λαμβάνειν, Jo 5:41, 2Pe 1:17, Ap 5:12; διδόναι δ. τ. θεῷ (cf. נָתַן כָּבוֹד לַיהוָֹה, Jr 13:16, al.), Lc 17:18, Jo 9:24, At 12:23, Rm 4:20, Ap 4:9; εἰς (τ.) δ. θεοῦ, Rm 3:7 15:7, Fp 1:11, al.; in doxologies, τ. θεῷ (ᾧ) ἡ δ., Lc 2:14, Rm 11:36 16:27, Gl 1:5, Ef 3:21, al.
__3. Later also (not cl.) as in LXX (= הוֹד, Jó 39:20, 1Cr 29:25; כָּבוֹד, Jó 19:9, Et 5:11, al.), visible brightness, splendour, glory: of light, At 22:11; of heavenly bodies, 1Co 15:40ff.; esp. that wh. radiates from God's presence, as manifested in the pillar of cloud and in the Holy of Holies (= כָּבוֹד, Êx 16:10 25:22 40:34, al.; and new Heb. שְׁכִינָה, 2Ma.2:8; see DB, iv, 489b), Rm 9:4, Tg 2:1 (see Hort, Mayor, in l.); hence of the manifested glory of God, Rm 1:23, Cl 1:11 Ef 1:6, 12 17 3:16; of the same as communicated to man through Christ, 2Co 3:18 4:6; and of the glorious condition into which Christians shall enter hereafter, Rm 8:18, 21 9:23, 2Tm 2:10, al.
SYN.: ἔπαινος τιμή (see Hort on 1Pe 1:7). (AS)

G1392.def:
δοξάζω
(δόξα), [in LXX chiefly for כָּבַד ni., pi., also for פָּאַר, etc. ;]
__1. to think, suppose, hold an opinion (Æsch., Plat., al.).
__2. To bestow δόξα (which see) on, to magnify, extol, praise (Thuc., iii, 45; Plut., al.): with accusative, Mt 5:16, Mc 2:12, Jo 8:54, Rm 15:6, 1Pe 2:12, al.; id. before ἐπί Lc 2:20; ἐν, Gl 1:24, 1Pe 4:16.
__3. In LXX and NT (see: δόξα, 3), to clothe with splendour, glorify (Êx 34:29-30, Sl 37:20, Is 44:23, Et 3:1, al): Rm 8:30, 2Co 3:10, 2Ts 3:1, 1Pe 1:8, al.; of Christ, Jo 7:39 8:54, al. (on the Johannine use, see Cremer, 211; Westc., Jo., Intr.); of the Father, Jo 13:31-32, 1Pe 4:11, al. (cf. ἐν-, συν-δοξάζω).
(AS)

G1393.def:
Δορκάς, -άδος, ἡ
(δορκάς, a gazelle),
Dorcas, also called Ταβειθά, which see: At 9:36, 39.†
(AS)

G1394.def:
δόσις, -εως, ἡ
(δίδωμι) [in LXX for חֹק (Gn 47:22), (Pv 21:14 25:14), frequently in Sir. ;]
__1. properly, the act of giving: Fp 4:15.
__2. Objectively, a gift: Tg 1:17.†
SYN.: see: δόμα (AS)

G1395.def:
δότης, -ου, ὁ
(δίδωμι), [in LXX: Pv 22:8 * ;]
= δοτήρ,
a giver: 2Co 9:7 (LXX) (not elsewhere).†
(AS)

G1396.def:
δουλαγωγέω, -ῶ
(δοῦλος, ἄγω),
to make a slave, bring into bondage: 1Co 9:27 (Cremer, 703).†
(AS)

G1397.def:
δουλεία (T, -λία), -ας, ἡ
(δουλεύω), [in LXX, as Êx 13:3, for עֶבֶד and cognates ;]
slavery, bondage: Rm 8:15, 21 Gl 4:24 5:1, Hb 2:15.†
(AS)

G1398.def:
δουλεύω
(δοῦλος), [in LXX for עָבַד, as Gn 14:4, exc. Da TH Dn 7:14, 27 (פְּלַח), Is 56:6 (שָׁרַת pi.)* ;]
to be a slave, be subject to, serve: absol., Rm 7:6, Gl 4:25, 1Tm 6:2; with dative of person(s), Mt 6:24, Lc 15:29 16:13, Rm 9:12" (LXX) ; of nations, Jo 8:33, At 7:7" (LXX) ; θεῷ, τ. κυρίῳ, Mt 6:24, Lc 16:13, At 20:19, Rm 12:11 (R, mg., καιρῷ) Rm 16:18, Ef 6:7, Cl 3:24, 1Ts 1:9; τ. Χριστῷ, Rm 14:18, Cl 3:24; νόμῳ θεοῦ, Rm 7:25; τ. θεοῖς, Gl 4:8; τ. καιρῷ, Rm 12:11 (R, mg. for κυρίῳ); ἀλλήλοις, Gl 5:13; σὺν ἐμοί Fp 2:22; τ. ἁμαρτίᾳ, Rm 6:6; νόμῳ ἁμαρτίας, Rm 7:25;
ἐπιθυμίαις κ. ἡδοναις, Tt 3:3; τ. κοιλία, Rm 16:18; μαμωνᾷ, Mt 6:24, Lc 16:13; τ. στοιχείοις τ, κόσμου, Gl 4:9 (Cremer, 217).†
(AS)
